effects.description: (4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal damage with a Light or Heavy Attack, you put a Mark of Revenge on the enemy for |cffffff15|r seconds. After stacking |cffffff5|r Marks of Revenge on an enemy they detonate for |cffffff1462|r Magic Damage.

You can only apply a stack once every half second and the damage scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
